source: KSQAAC Spardha Yashassu NMMS Study Material 2022, MAT Chapter 32 (questions: PDF pages 90–92, key: PDF page 168)

questions.prompt: P and Q are brothers. R and S are sisters. P's son is S's brother. How is Q related to R?
questions.rule: P's son is S's brother, so S (and her sister R) are also P's children.
questions.working: Q is the brother of R's father P, so Q is R's uncle
questions.note: The book's key says B (Father), but its own diagram marks Q as R's uncle.

questions.prompt: Amit is the son of Rahul. Rahul's sister Sarika has a son, Sonu, and a daughter, Rita. Raju is Sonu's maternal uncle. How is Rita related to Raju?
questions.rule: Raju is Sonu's maternal uncle, so he is the brother of Sonu's mother, Sarika.
questions.working: Rita is the daughter of Raju's sister, so Rita is Raju's niece

questions.prompt: Pointing to a photo, a man said, “Her only brother's son is the brother of my wife.” How is the lady related to the man?
questions.rule: The lady's brother's son is the wife's brother, so the lady's brother is the wife's father: the man's father-in-law.
questions.working: So the lady is the sister of the man's father-in-law. None of the options says that
questions.note: Hidden until checked: the key says D (sister of maternal uncle), but the lady is the sister of the man's father-in-law (his wife's aunt). No option fits exactly.

questions.prompt: P is the father of R. S is a son of Q. T is the brother of P. R is a sister of S. How is Q related to T?
questions.rule: R and S are brother and sister, so they have the same parents. P is their father, so Q is their mother, P's wife.
questions.working: Q is the wife of T's brother P, so Q is T's sister-in-law
questions.note: The book's key says C (Brother-in-law), but Q is the mother of R and S, so Q is a woman: T's sister-in-law.

questions.prompt: Pointing to a boy, a girl said, “He is the son of the daughter of my uncle's father.” How is the boy related to the girl?
questions.rule: The girl's uncle's father is her grandfather, and his daughter is her mother (or her aunt).
questions.working: The son of her mother is her brother. (An aunt's son would be a cousin, which is not an option.) So he is her brother
questions.note: The book's key says C (Brother-in-law; the Kannada option C is nephew), but neither fits: the boy is the girl's brother or cousin, and only Brother is offered.

questions.prompt: Anand is the son of Prema. Raju is the brother of Prema. Neha has a daughter, Rashmi. Neha is the sister of Raju. How is Anand related to Rashmi?
questions.rule: Prema, Raju and Neha are brothers and sisters. Anand is Prema's son, and Rashmi is Neha's daughter.
questions.working: Their mothers are sisters, so Anand is Rashmi's cousin
questions.note: The English book says “Rashmi has a daughter Neha”. The Kannada says Neha has a daughter Rashmi, which is the reading the key's answer needs.

questions.prompt: Anand and Badri are brothers. Vasanth is the sister of Anand. Deva is the brother of Eashwari. Eashwari is the daughter of Badri. Who is Deva's uncle?
questions.rule: Eashwari is Badri's daughter and Deva is her brother, so Badri is Deva's father.
questions.working: Deva's father's brother is Anand, so Anand is Deva's uncle. (Badri is his father, and Vasanth is his aunt.)

questions.prompt: A is the brother of F. C is the daughter of A. F's daughter is K. G is the brother of C. Who is G's uncle?
questions.rule: G is C's brother, so G is also A's son.
questions.working: F is the brother of G's father A, so F is G's uncle
questions.note: The English doesn't say that F is a man, which “uncle” needs. The Kannada version says F is A's brother.

questions.prompt: Introducing Y, X said, “He is the husband of the granddaughter of my father's father.” How is Y related to X?
questions.rule: The granddaughter of X's father's father is X's sister (or cousin).
questions.working: Y is her husband, so Y is X's brother-in-law
questions.note: The book's key says A (Brother), but Y is married to X's sister, which makes him X's brother-in-law.

questions.prompt: Pointing to a woman, Raju said, “She is the daughter of the mother of my mother's husband.” How is the woman related to Raju?
questions.rule: Raju's mother's husband is his father, and his father's mother is Raju's grandmother.
questions.working: The grandmother's daughter is his father's sister: Raju's aunt

questions.prompt: Pointing to a lady, Kumar said, “Your mother's husband's sister is my mother-in-law.” How is Kumar related to that lady?
questions.rule: The lady's mother's husband is her father, and his sister is her aunt. That aunt is Kumar's mother-in-law.
questions.working: So Kumar's wife is the lady's cousin. Kumar is a man, but every option is a woman's relation
questions.note: Hidden until checked: none of the options can describe Kumar, who is a man. The key says D (Sister); the question may have meant Kumar's wife.

questions.prompt: A is the mother of B. C is the son of A. D is the brother of E. E is the daughter of B. Who is D's grandmother?
questions.rule: E is B's daughter and D is E's brother, so D is B's son.
questions.working: B's mother is A, so A is D's grandmother

questions.prompt: E is the son of A. D is the son of B. E is married to C. C is the daughter of B. How is D related to E?
questions.rule: C and D are both B's children, so D is C's brother.
questions.working: D is the brother of E's wife, so D is E's brother-in-law

questions.prompt: A is the brother of B. C and D are brothers. A's son is D's brother. How is B related to C?
questions.rule: A's son is D's brother, so C and D are A's sons.
questions.working: B is the brother of their father A, so B is C's uncle

questions.prompt: A is the brother of B. C is the father of D. E is the mother of B. A and D are brothers. How is E related to C?
questions.rule: A, B and D are brothers and sisters, so they share parents: C is their father and E is their mother.
questions.working: E is the mother of C's children, so E is C's wife
questions.note: The English options in the book are Sister, Sister-in-law, Niece and Wife. The key (B) matches the Kannada options, used here, where B is Wife.
